headline: Existing eligible channels remove19 of39 modeled oil-access tails
evidence_basis: 284 strict paired origins; corrected coordinates; job-fit/operator scenario
recommended_decision: Build eligible owned-channel routing and target residual-access tests

headline: Oil substitution and general-workshop preservation imply different branch choices
inference_boundary: Job-specific substitution is distinct from general-workshop network geometry
recommended_decision: Protect general-workshop availability while routing eligible routine work
lower_priority_alternative: Treating zero oil tails as general-workshop redundancy

headline: Soekarno-Hatta combines residual access with reported return-visit mechanisms
evidence_basis: Eight residual model origins plus selected M08/M09 accounts | Interview update: The HEV interview branch is undisclosed.
inference_boundary: Selected accounts do not estimate failure prevalence
recommended_decision: Add approved scope and the driver-to-approver handoff to the preparedness test; verify the actual branch cohort.

headline: Intended paid service can be lost at acknowledgement
evidence_basis: M01explicitpaidVelozarrival;M03walk-inqueue;M02historicalunnamedapp | Interview update: The interviews supply successful routine comparators, not a measured failure rate.
inference_boundary: Not a network failure rate or proof of current Digiroom defect
recommended_decision: Keep successful WhatsApp entry and test all-channel acknowledgement and closure in a defined cohort.
lower_priority_alternative: Acquisition or app-install campaigns before reception control

headline: Repair retention can compete with vehicle replacement
inference_boundary: BundledRp25m is not verified Auto2000 invoice; repair equivalence unknown
recommended_decision: Offer retain/repair/replace alternatives and count outcomes once
lower_priority_alternative: Counting immediate repair and immediate replacement as additive for one owner

headline: Toyota HEV continuity and BEV acquisition require different task paths
evidence_basis: Case mostly hybrid; external modelmix; YouTubeBYD/Neta sample | Interview update: The cases contrast fixed residential charging and low-charge travel adaptations.
inference_boundary: External hybrid denominator differs from caseToyotaEVestimate
recommended_decision: Lead HEV ownership with relevant tasks and offer route/fallback support to BEV households where charging conditions warrant it.
lower_priority_alternative: Using selected BEV resale discourse as Toyota-owner demand prevalence

headline: Entitlement timing limits near-horizon paid routine-service claims
evidence_type: Programme terms and conditional calendar model
evidence_basis: Sevencoveredtime-basedevents;month42example;paidXTRAconditions | Interview update: The reported covered service does not establish customer-paid work.
inference_boundary: Mileage and uncovered work differ; not a BEV schedule forecast
recommended_decision: Track covered, reimbursed and customer-paid work separately; validate paid or mixed HEV opportunities at the branch.

headline: Accepted evidence must lead to an executable net-upgrade offer
evidence_basis: ExistingHHC/tradein;TRIVAreviewmentionsM19/M20;finance/settlement dependencies | Interview update: Actual research ended at an indicative price range; a stated floor preference does not establish a purchase response.
inference_boundary: Not a validated battery premium or universal residual guarantee
recommended_decision: Test an inspected written net-upgrade offer; treat top-up and full-floor choices as separate later commercial tests.
lower_priority_alternative: Another detached certificate or speculative universal price floor

headline: A confirmed household-relevant demonstration addresses an acquisition obstruction

headline: All-channel incremental recognized contribution is the relevant profit bridge
evidence_basis: Case84%bookingsoutsideapp;operatorandpayerperimeter | Interview update: Routine WhatsApp bookings already closed in two accounts; repeated digital use is a testable hypothesis.
inference_boundary: Channel migration and ecosystem capture are distinct from incrementalAuto2000GP
recommended_decision: Measure incremental completion and payer-specific contribution against normal service, alongside useful digital return.
lower_priority_alternative: Adding appbookings, referrals and hypothetical future purchases as newGP

headline: A driver can run the service visit while a different family member controls added spend
evidence_type: Interview self-reports, elicited concept and cross-source pilot hypothesis
evidence_basis: Wuling driver approves and pays before reimbursement; Yaris driver runs service while father approves paid extra work. Yaris driver interested in a work record. M08/M09 describe scope/return problems at a different branch.
inference_boundary: The interview cases establish roles and current channel sufficiency. Pilot branch eligibility, app use and commercial effect remain to be measured.
recommended_decision: Test a Digiroom service and approval record alongside WhatsApp with Yaris Cross Hybrid owners at Auto2000 Soekarno-Hatta, conditional on branch readiness.
lower_priority_alternative: Compulsory app booking or an upfront resale guarantee as the first pilot
